text.zh-CN:
骨关节炎会使关节疼痛、僵硬和活动受限，常见于膝、髋和手部。

- 关节表面的软骨及周围组织发生改变，不能简单理解为骨头缺钙。
- 活动时可能疼痛，休息后起步时也可能僵硬。
- 影像变化、疼痛和实际活动能力不一定完全一致。
text.en:
Osteoarthritis causes joint pain, stiffness and reduced movement, often in knees, hips and hands.

- Cartilage and surrounding tissues change; it is not simply calcium deficiency.
- Pain may occur with use and stiffness after rest.
- Symptoms and function need assessment alongside any imaging findings.

text.zh-CN:
发生风险与关节承受的条件有关。

- 年龄增加、既往损伤和家族因素会影响风险。
- 体重过高会增加膝髋等负重关节的负担。
- 其他关节病造成的损伤，也可能随后出现骨关节炎。
text.en:
Risk depends on several joint-related factors.

- Age, previous injury and family history contribute.
- Excess weight increases load on knees and hips.
- Damage from another joint disease can also contribute.

text.zh-CN:
突然的变化需要重新判断。

- 关节突然明显红、热、肿，尤其伴发热，不应直接归为旧病。
- 外伤后不能负重或有明显变形，需要尽快评估。
- 疼痛快速加重并全身不适时，应及时就医排除其他原因。
text.en:
Sudden changes call for reassessment.

- A newly hot, red, swollen joint with fever should not be assumed to be usual osteoarthritis.
- Inability to bear weight or deformity after injury needs prompt care.
- Rapid worsening with systemic illness requires another cause to be considered.

text.zh-CN:
持续影响生活就值得接受评估。

- 疼痛妨碍走路、上下楼、穿衣或睡眠，应讨论治疗。
- 晨僵持续较久、关节持续肿胀，需排查其他关节炎。
- 既有方案不能帮助活动，或止痛药带来不适，应复诊调整。
text.en:
Seek review when symptoms persist or limit life.

- Walking, stairs, dressing or sleep difficulties justify treatment discussion.
- Prolonged morning stiffness or persistent swelling needs assessment for other arthritis.
- Review ineffective treatment or medicine-related discomfort.

text.zh-CN:
诊断通常从问诊和查体开始。

- 医生会了解疼痛与活动的关系、僵硬时长和受影响关节。
- 检查关节活动范围、肿胀和功能。
- 典型情况不一定需要拍片；检查主要用于不典型表现或排除其他病因。
text.en:
Diagnosis often starts with history and examination.

- Describe how pain relates to activity and how long stiffness lasts.
- Movement, swelling and function are examined.
- Typical cases may not need imaging; tests help when the pattern is unusual.

text.zh-CN:
关节痛并非都属于骨关节炎。

- 类风湿关节炎等炎症性疾病可出现持续肿胀或较长晨僵。
- 痛风可能突然发作，与长期机械性疼痛不同。
- 外伤、骨折和感染需要不同处理，不能只靠年龄判断。
text.en:
Not every painful joint has osteoarthritis.

- Inflammatory arthritis may cause persistent swelling and prolonged morning stiffness.
- Gout can present as a sudden attack.
- Injury, fracture and infection require different care; age alone cannot distinguish them.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标是减轻症状并保留活动。

- 规律运动和针对肌肉力量的训练是核心，而非把关节完全闲置。
- 体重偏高时逐步减重可减轻负重关节压力。
- 辅助器具、药物或少数情况下手术，按功能受限程度选择。
text.en:
Treatment aims to relieve symptoms and preserve function.

- Regular activity and strengthening are central rather than complete joint rest.
- Weight reduction when appropriate may reduce joint load.
- Aids, medicines and occasionally surgery are selected according to functional impact.

text.zh-CN:
药物主要缓解症状，不能直接重建软骨。

- 外用消炎止痛药可用于部分膝或手关节疼痛。
- 口服消炎止痛药需核对胃溃疡和心血管病等风险，必要时配合胃保护。
- 阿片类可能嗜睡和便秘；注射或其他止痛方案需讨论收益和持续时间。
text.en:
Medicines relieve symptoms rather than rebuild cartilage.

- Topical anti-inflammatory medicines can help some knee or hand pain.
- Oral versions require review of ulcer and cardiovascular risks, sometimes with stomach protection.
- Opioids may cause drowsiness and constipation; injections also need a benefit discussion.

text.zh-CN:
饮食目标是营养充足与合适体重。

- 体重偏高者可用可持续饮食减少关节负荷。
- 不用一种食物或保健品代替活动和正规的疼痛管理。
- 氨基葡萄糖、软骨素等并没有足够强的证据可保证治疗效果。
text.en:
Diet supports nutrition and appropriate weight.

- Sustainable weight management can reduce joint loading when needed.
- No food or supplement replaces activity and pain management.
- Glucosamine and chondroitin do not have strong evidence guaranteeing benefit.

text.zh-CN:
护理需要活动与休息配合。

- 按能力分段完成家务，避免一次长时间重复负重。
- 适合的鞋、手杖或开瓶辅助器具可减少困难，先学习正确使用。
- 运动逐渐增加；突然明显加重时调整，而非永远停止活动。
text.en:
Balance activity with suitable breaks.

- Divide tasks to avoid prolonged repeated loading.
- Footwear, walking aids or hand tools can ease tasks when used correctly.
- Increase exercise gradually and adjust for marked worsening rather than abandoning activity permanently.

text.zh-CN:
不同人的方案取决于能力和共病。

- 老年人仍可从合适训练获益，活动量按基础能力调整。
- 胃病、心血管病或正在用其他药的人，止痛药风险需要单独核对。
- 手部或下肢受累者，可分别接受生活工具或步行辅助评估。
text.en:
Plans depend on ability and other conditions.

- Older people can benefit from appropriately adapted exercise.
- Ulcer, cardiovascular disease or other medicines affect painkiller choices.
- Hand and lower-limb disease may need different daily-living aids.

text.zh-CN:
骨关节炎不一定持续恶化。

- 症状可能波动，一些人长期保持较好的功能。
- 随访关注走路、睡眠及日常任务是否改善。
- 若考虑手术，要讨论预期获益及仍可能残留的疼痛和僵硬。
text.en:
Osteoarthritis does not inevitably worsen.

- Symptoms fluctuate and function may remain satisfactory for years.
- Follow-up should assess walking, sleep and daily tasks.
- Surgery discussions should include expected benefits and possible residual symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
长期疼痛主要影响功能和生活。

- 关节活动受限可能让穿衣、购物或上下楼困难。
- 因为疼痛而长期不动可加重肌力下降和僵硬。
- 持续疼痛也可能影响情绪，需要纳入整体支持。
text.en:
Persistent symptoms can affect everyday function.

- Dressing, shopping and stairs may become difficult.
- Prolonged inactivity can worsen weakness and stiffness.
- Pain may also affect mood and deserves broader support.

text.zh-CN:
以下措施有助降低风险。

- 运动中逐渐增加负荷，关节受伤后给予合适恢复。
- 维持合适体重，减少负重关节长期过大压力。
- 避免久处同一姿势，工作中安排适量活动。
text.en:
These measures can help reduce risk.

- Increase loads gradually and allow recovery after injury.
- Maintain suitable weight to limit excess joint loading.
- Vary posture and include movement during work.

limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.
